# Third Level Essay Competition

_March 2021_

Foras na Gaeilge’s Lexicography Department are running an essay competition for students in third level education and there are some great prizes to be won. See poster and information sheet below. Students who wish to enter the competition are advised to read the information sheet carefully.

## [Information Sheet](https://www.teanglann.ie/news/aisti2021-bileog.pdf)

PDF File

## [Poster](https://www.teanglann.ie/news/aisti2021-postaer.pdf)

PDF File

As essays will be accepted in Irish only, the information sheet and poster are available in Irish only.
